text_en: These are the descendants of Esau (that is, Edom).
text_cn: 以下是厄撒乌，即厄东的后裔：

text_en: Esau took his wives from the Canaanites: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah daughter of Anah son of Zibeon the Hivite,
text_cn: 厄撒乌由客纳罕女人中娶的妻子，有赫特人厄隆的女儿阿达，有曷黎人漆贝红之子阿纳的女儿敖曷里巴玛；

text_en: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
text_cn: 还有依市玛耳的女儿，乃巴约特的姊妹巴色玛特。

text_en: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau; Basemath bore Reuel;
text_cn: 阿达给厄撒乌生了厄里法次；巴色玛特生了勒乌耳；

text_en: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
text_cn: 敖曷里巴玛生了耶乌士、雅蓝和科辣黑：以上都是厄撒乌在客纳罕地生的儿子。

text_en: Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, his cattle, all his livestock, and all the property he had acquired in the land of Canaan; and he moved to a land some distance from his brother Jacob.
text_cn: 厄撒乌带了自己的妻子儿女，和家中所有的人，并自己所有的牛羊家畜，以及在客纳罕地所获得的财物，迁移到色依尔， 离开他的弟弟雅各伯，

text_en: For their possessions were too great for them to live together; the land where they were staying could not support them because of their livestock.
text_cn: 因为他们家产太多，不能住在一起；他们寄居的地方，由于家畜太多，也容不下他们。

text_en: So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir; Esau is Edom.
text_cn: 厄撒乌就住在色依尔山地。厄撒乌即是厄东。

text_en: These are the descendants of Esau, ancestor of the Edomites, in the hill country of Seir.
text_cn: 以下是色依尔山地厄东人的始祖厄撒乌的后裔。

text_en: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz son of Adah the wife of Esau; Reuel, the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
text_cn: 以下是厄撒乌子孙的名谱：厄撒乌的妻子阿达的儿子厄里法次；厄撒乌的妻子巴色玛特的儿子勒乌耳。

text_en: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
text_cn: 厄里法次的儿子：特曼、敖玛尔、则缶（fǒu）、加堂和刻纳次。

text_en: (Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz, Esau’s son; she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. ) These were the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
text_cn: 厄撒乌的儿子厄里法次的妾提默纳给厄里法次生了阿玛肋克： 以上是厄撒乌的妻子阿达的子孙。

text_en: These were the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Esau’s wife, Basemath.
text_cn: 勒乌耳的儿子：纳哈特、则辣黑、沙玛和米匝：以上是厄撒乌的妻子巴色玛特的子孙。

text_en: These were the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah, daughter of Anah son of Zibeon: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
text_cn: 以下是漆贝红之子阿纳的女儿，厄撒乌的妻子敖曷里巴玛的儿子：她给厄撒乌生了耶乌士、雅蓝和科辣黑。

text_en: These are the clans of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: the clans Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
text_cn: 以下是厄撒乌子孙中的族长：厄撒乌的长子厄里法次的子孙中，有特曼族长，敖玛尔族长，则缶族长，刻纳次族长，

text_en: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek; these are the clans of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; they are the sons of Adah.
text_cn: 科辣黑族长，加堂族长和阿玛肋克族长：以上是厄东地厄里法次族的族长，都是阿达的子孙。

text_en: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: the clans Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah; these are the clans of Reuel in the land of Edom; they are the sons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
text_cn: 厄撒乌的儿子勒乌耳的子孙中，有纳哈特族长，则辣黑族长，沙玛族长和米匝族长：以上是厄东地勒乌耳族的族长，都是厄撒乌的妻子巴色玛特的子孙。

text_en: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: the clans Jeush, Jalam, and Korah; these are the clans born of Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
text_cn: 厄撒乌的妻子敖曷里巴玛的子孙中有耶乌士族长，雅蓝族长和科辣黑族长：以上是阿纳的女儿，厄撒乌的妻子敖曷里巴玛子孙中的族长。

text_en: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their clans.
text_cn: 以上都是厄撒乌的子孙，都是族长。这就是厄东。

text_en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
text_cn: 以下是当地居民曷黎人色依尔的子孙：罗堂、芍巴耳、漆贝红、阿雅、

text_en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan; these are the clans of the Horites, the sons of Seir in the land of Edom.
text_cn: 狄雄、厄责尔和狄商：以上是厄东地色依尔子孙曷黎人的族长。

text_en: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Heman; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
text_cn: 罗堂的儿子：曷黎和赫曼；罗堂的姊妹是提默纳。

text_en: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
text_cn: 芍巴耳的儿子：阿耳汪、玛纳哈特、厄巴耳、舍佛和敖南。

text_en: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah; he is the Anah who found the springs in the wilderness, as he pastured the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
text_cn: 漆贝红的儿子：阿雅和阿纳；那在旷野里牧放他父亲漆贝红的驴，发现温泉的，就是这位阿纳。

text_en: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
text_cn: 阿纳的儿子狄雄；阿纳的女儿就是敖曷里巴玛。

text_en: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
text_cn: 狄雄的儿子：赫默丹、厄市班、依特兰和革兰。

text_en: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
text_cn: 厄责尔的儿子：彼耳汉、匝汪和阿甘。

text_en: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
text_cn: 狄商的儿子：伍兹和阿郎。

text_en: These are the clans of the Horites: the clans Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
text_cn: 以下是曷黎人的族长：罗堂族长，芍巴耳族长，漆贝红族长，阿纳族长，

text_en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan; these are the clans of the Horites, clan by clan in the land of Seir.
text_cn: 狄雄族长，厄责尔族长和狄商族长：以上是色依尔地曷黎人各族的族长。

text_en: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the Israelites.
text_cn: 以下是在以色列子民未有君王统治以前，统治厄东地的君王。

text_en: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom, the name of his city being Dinhabah.
text_cn: 贝敖尔的儿子贝拉在厄东作王，他的京城名叫丁哈巴。

text_en: Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah of Bozrah succeeded him as king.
text_cn: 贝拉死后，波责辣人则辣黑的儿子约巴布继他为王。

text_en: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.
text_cn: 约巴布死后，特曼地人胡商继他为王。

text_en: Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king, the name of his city being Avith.
text_cn: 胡商死后，贝达得的儿子哈达得继他为王，他曾在摩阿布平原击败了米德杨人。他的京城名叫阿威特。

text_en: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah succeeded him as king.
text_cn: 哈达得死后，玛斯勒卡人撒默拉继他为王。

text_en: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth on the Euphrates succeeded him as king.
text_cn: 撒默拉死后，河间的勒曷波特人沙乌耳继他为王。

text_en: Shaul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor succeeded him as king.
text_cn: 沙乌耳死后，阿革波尔的儿子巴耳哈南继他为王。

text_en: Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, and Hadar succeeded him as king, the name of his city being Pau; his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-zahab.
text_cn: 阿革波尔的儿子巴耳哈南死后，哈达得继他为王；他的京城名叫帕乌。他的妻子名叫默塔贝耳，是默匝哈布人玛特勒得的女儿。

text_en: These are the names of the clans of Esau, according to their families and their localities by their names: the clans Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
text_cn: 厄撒乌族的族长名称，依族系和地区名列如下：提默纳族长，阿耳瓦族长，耶太特族长，

text_en: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
text_cn: 敖曷里巴玛族长，厄拉族长，丕农族长，

text_en: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
text_cn: 刻纳次族长，特曼族长，米贝匝尔族长，

text_en: Magdiel, and Iram; these are the clans of Edom (that is, Esau, the father of Edom), according to their settlements in the land that they held.
text_cn: 玛革狄耳族长和依兰族长：以上是厄东人在所占有的地方，依住区所有的族长。厄东人的始祖即是厄撒乌。
